After 2 h of nutritional stress, T. brucei cells were harvested.'

limitations: Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm is the MaxQuant 1.6.1.0 default main-search tolerance (not listed in parameters.txt); the deposited evidence.txt has max |mass error| 4.514 ppm over 70,053 MS/MS evidences, consistent with it.
sdrf-tools reconcile flags Trypsin as not named in the PRIDE record; it is the MaxQuant search enzyme (summary.txt) for in-gel digestion per the cited protocol.

The paper states Lister 427 wild-type and 29-13 procyclic cells were used and LCCR4-HA was expressed from pLew100 (requires 29-13 T7RNAP/TetR); the 29-13 background and procyclic stage for the LCCR4-HA line are inferred from this system, not stated explicitly.
Light channel treatment is encoded as 'control' (EFO:0001461) = no tetracycline; 'untreated' would be incorrect because all samples were PBS-stressed.
